# wso2is_role_assignment (Resource)

Manages the complete list of users and groups that have a role. The provider removes any assignment that is not in the list. Use only one `wso2is_role_assignment` for each role. Every user also has the built-in `everyone` role, which this resource does not manage. To import, use the role ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "wso2is_role" "support" {
  name = "support"
}

resource "wso2is_group" "support" {
  name = "support"
}

resource "wso2is_role_assignment" "support" {
  role_id   = wso2is_role.support.id
  group_ids = [wso2is_group.support.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `role_id` (String) Role ID.

### Optional

- `group_ids` (Set of String) IDs of groups assigned the role.
- `user_ids` (Set of String) IDs of users assigned the role.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as `role_id`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import wso2is_role_assignment.support <role_id>
```
